name: Mojito - strix-KSUNext-susfs

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  ARCH: arm64
  SUBARCH: arm64
  DEFCONFIG: mojito_defconfig
  CROSS_COMPILE: aarch64-linux-gnu-
  CROSS_COMPILE_ARM32: arm-linux-gnueabi-
  CROSS_COMPILE_COMPAT: arm-linux-gnueabi-

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04

    steps:
      - name: Télécharger le source
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: 16.2
          fetch-depth: 1
          submodules: recursive

      - name: Installer les dépendances
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            bc bison build-essential ccache flex git libssl-dev \
            libelf-dev pahole python3 rsync unzip wget zip \
            gcc-aarch64-linux-gnu binutils-aarch64-linux-gnu \
            gcc-arm-linux-gnueabi binutils-arm-linux-gnueabi \
            clang lld llvm
 
      - name: Télécharger et appliquer les patchs KernelSU et SuSFS
        run: |
          git clone --depth=1 -b main https://github.com/nanix06/Patch_Ksu_SuSFS.git patches
          patch -p1 --fuzz=3 < patches/Patches/SU_kernel/patch_ksunext.patch || true
          patch -p1 --fuzz=3 < patches/Patches/SuSFS_Kernel/50_add_susfs_in_kernel-4.14.patch || true
          patch -p1 --fuzz=3 < patches/Patches/Fix/susfs_fix_nameic.patch || true
          patch -p1 --fuzz=3 < patches/Patches/Fix/susfs_fix_statc.patch || true
          patch -p1 --fuzz=3 < patches/Patches/SuSFS_Kernel/55_try_umount_for_susfs.patch || true
          patch -p1 --fuzz=3 < patches/Patches/SU_kernel/patch_ksu_path_umount.patch || true
          sed -i 's/inotify_mark_user_mask(mark)/(mark->mask \& IN_ALL_EVENTS)/g' fs/notify/fdinfo.c
          sed -i '/^orig_flow:$/a\\t\t;' fs/notify/fdinfo.c
          sed -i '0,/^static void susfs_run_sus_path_loop(void) {/s//void susfs_run_sus_path_loop(void) {/' fs/susfs.c

      - name: Ajouter KernelSU-Next
        run: |
          git clone --depth=1 -b legacy https://github.com/KernelSU-Next/KernelSU-Next.git KernelSU
          ln -s ../KernelSU/kernel drivers/kernelsu
          sed -i 's/get_monotonic_boottime(&ts)/get_monotonic_boottime64(\&ts)/' KernelSU/kernel/sulog/event.c
          sed -i '/#include <linux\/uaccess.h>/a #include <linux/timekeeping.h>' KernelSU/kernel/sulog/event.c

          bash patches/Patches/Fix/fix_sepolicy_mojito.sh KernelSU

          printf '%s\n' \
            '#define KSU_TYPE_VAL_TO_STRUCT' \
            '#include "ss/avtab.h"' \
            '#include "ss/constraint.h"' \
            '#include "ss/ebitmap.h"' \
            '#include "ss/hashtab.h"' \
            '#include "ss/policydb.h"' \
            '#include "ss/services.h"' \
            '#include "ss/symtab.h"' \
            '#include <linux/gfp.h>' \
            '#include <linux/kernel.h>' \
            '#include <linux/printk.h>' \
            '#include <linux/slab.h>' \
            '#include <linux/stddef.h>' \
            '#include <linux/string.h>' \
            '#include <linux/types.h>' \
            '#include <linux/version.h>' \
            '#include <linux/vmalloc.h>' \
            | cat - KernelSU/kernel/selinux/sepolicy.c > /tmp/sepolicy.c.net \
            && mv /tmp/sepolicy.c.net KernelSU/kernel/selinux/sepolicy.c

          cp patches/Patches/SuSFS_Ksu/susfs_patch_ksunext.patch KernelSU/
          cd KernelSU
          patch -p1 < susfs_patch_ksunext.patch || true
          cd ..

      - name: Ajouter KProfiles
        run: |
          git clone --depth=1 \
            https://github.com/beakthoven/Kprofiles.git \
            drivers/misc/kprofiles

          printf '\nsource "drivers/misc/kprofiles/Kconfig"\n' >> drivers/misc/Kconfig
          printf '\nobj-$(CONFIG_KPROFILES) += kprofiles/\n' >> drivers/misc/Makefile  

      - name: Configurer le noyau
        run: |
          export PATH="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/clang/bin:$PATH"

          mkdir -p out

          make O=out ARCH=arm64 \
            CC=clang \
            CLANG_TRIPLE=aarch64-linux-gnu- \
            CROSS_COMPILE="$CROSS_COMPILE" \
            CROSS_COMPILE_ARM32="$CROSS_COMPILE_ARM32" \
            CROSS_COMPILE_COMPAT="$CROSS_COMPILE_COMPAT" \
            LLVM=1 \
            LLVM_IAS=1 \
            "$DEFCONFIG"

          # KernelSU
          ./scripts/config --file out/.config --enable KSU
          ./scripts/config --file out/.config --enable CONFIG_KALLSYMS_ALL

          # SUSFS
          ./scripts/config --file out/.config --enable KSU_SUSFS
          ./scripts/config --file out/.config --enable KSU_SUSFS_HAS_MAGIC_MOUNT
          ./scripts/config --file out/.config --enable KSU_SUSFS_SUS_PATH
          ./scripts/config --file out/.config --enable KSU_SUSFS_SUS_MOUNT
          ./scripts/config --file out/.config --enable KSU_SUSFS_SUS_KSTAT
          ./scripts/config --file out/.config --enable KSU_SUSFS_SUS_OVERLAYFS
          ./scripts/config --file out/.config --enable KSU_SUSFS_TRY_UMOUNT
          ./scripts/config --file out/.config --enable KSU_SUSFS_SPOOF_UNAME_RELEASE
          ./scripts/config --file out/.config --enable KSU_SUSFS_SUS_MAP
          ./scripts/config --file out/.config --enable KSU_SUSFS_SPOOF_CMDLINE_OR_BOOTCONFIG
          

          ./scripts/config --file out/.config \
            --set-str LOCALVERSION "-Strix"
          ./scripts/config --file out/.config --disable CONFIG_LOCALVERSION_AUTO

          # Evite le build cassé du compat vDSO avec LLVM
          ./scripts/config --file out/.config --disable CONFIG_COMPAT_VDSO

          make O=out ARCH=arm64 \
            CC=clang \
            CLANG_TRIPLE=aarch64-linux-gnu- \
            CROSS_COMPILE="$CROSS_COMPILE" \
            CROSS_COMPILE_ARM32="$CROSS_COMPILE_ARM32" \
            CROSS_COMPILE_COMPAT="$CROSS_COMPILE_COMPAT" \
            LLVM=1 \
            LLVM_IAS=1 \
            olddefconfig
            
      - name: Compiler le noyau
        run: |
          make -j"$(nproc)" O=out ARCH=arm64 \
            CC=clang \
            CLANG_TRIPLE=aarch64-linux-gnu- \
            CROSS_COMPILE="$CROSS_COMPILE" \
            CROSS_COMPILE_ARM32="$CROSS_COMPILE_ARM32" \
            CROSS_COMPILE_COMPAT="$CROSS_COMPILE_COMPAT" \
            KCFLAGS="-Wno-visibility -Wno-unused-but-set-variable -Wno-int-conversion -Wno-fortify-source" \
            LLVM=1 \
            LLVM_IAS=1

      - name: Préparer les fichiers
        run: |
          mkdir -p release
          cp out/arch/arm64/boot/Image.gz release/ 2>/dev/null || true
          cp out/arch/arm64/boot/Image.gz-dtb release/ 2>/dev/null || true
          cp out/arch/arm64/boot/Image release/ 2>/dev/null || true
          sha256sum release/* > release/SHA256SUMS

      - name: Envoyer l’artefact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: Mojito-strix-KernelSU
          path: release/
          if-no-files-found: error
